raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Muse Spark's fused decode/verify KV store assumes contiguous per-layer cache rows. Unified KV memory interleaves layers in each token row, so this path rejects the strided cache during CUDA graph capture.

## Modifications

- When unified memory is enabled, reuse Muse Spark's existing prefill QK norm/RoPE preparation and the attention backend's strided KV writer for decode and target verification. Forward modes, speculative masks, and the `trtllm_mha` backend remain unchanged.
- Resolve the implicit FA4 draft KV dtype when deciding fused draft placement. A BF16 DFLASH-family draft now keeps a separate pool when the target uses FP8, avoiding a dtype mismatch at draft binding.

- Add `test_muse_spark_unified_memory.py` to `extra-b-test-4-gpu-b200`, using the validated TP4/EP4 launch settings and a full GSM8K accuracy gate of 0.93. Pass the existing gated-model credential to this suite and its named main-branch rerun, preserving the rerun PR-head restriction.

## Accuracy Tests

Tested on 4 B200 GPUs with `meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4`, TP4/EP4, `modelopt_fp4`, `flashinfer_trtllm` MoE, `trtllm_mha` attention, unified memory, FP8 KV, page size 128, layernorm SP and MegaMoE. DFLASH uses `RadixArk/Muse-Spark-Open-DFlash2`, FA4, and 8 draft tokens. Native context length is 1,048,576; multimodal features use CPU transport and HiCache is disabled.

The new registered GSM8K test passed on 4 B200 GPUs: **1285/1319 (97.42%)**, with zero request errors, zero truncated responses, and zero invalid answers. It uses 64 evaluation workers, a 32,768-token output cap, temperature 1, top-p 0.95, and xhigh reasoning. The unmodified test file completed its server startup, evaluation, assertions, and graceful teardown in 263 seconds. Pre-commit and actionlint passed for the new test and CI changes.

All three evaluations use temperature 1, top-p 0.95, and xhigh reasoning:

| Evaluation | Configuration | Correct / total | Accuracy |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AIME26 | 30 problems × 8 repeats, 400K output cap | 226 / 240 | 94.17% |
| GPQA Diamond | 198 questions, 250K output cap | 178 / 198 | 89.90% |
| Video-MME | 900 short questions, 96-frame input videos, no subtitles | 787 / 900 | 87.44% |

One AIME and one GPQA response reached the configured output cap; both remain in the denominators. Actual DFLASH verification counters were recorded for responses.

Existing cache-placement and kernel tests passed on the runtime implementation in this PR. Text and image server smoke checks passed; CUDA graphs are enabled. Pre-commit passed for all changed files.

Fixed-input CUDA graph replay checks passed bit for bit: original packed fused QK norm/RoPE/KV store vs the fallback with 16-layer GQA and 46-layer SWA strided FP8 views (1, 8, 17, 128, and 512 tokens); TRT-LLM decode and 8-token verify with packed vs strided caches at 8K/64K context lengths, including SWA. Each case replays three times with changed inputs and cache locations/page tables.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Isolated QK norm/RoPE/cache-store timings on B200, in microseconds per layer (10 calls per CUDA graph, 100 timed replays):

| Tokens | Packed fused GQA | Unified fallback GQA | Packed fused SWA/RoPE | Unified fallback SWA/RoPE |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1.23 | 3.07 | 1.23 | 3.08 |
| 8 | 1.23 | 3.48 | 1.44 | 3.69 |
| 128 | 2.21 | 4.31 | 2.25 | 4.51 |
| 512 | 4.30 | 5.53 | 4.92 | 6.27 |

The fallback uses the existing separate preparation and cache-write kernels. These are operator timings; no end-to-end throughput comparison is claimed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.
- [x] Provide accuracy and focused performance evidence.
- [x] Update the Muse Spark cookbook in the separate PR #45360.

@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+"""Muse Spark unified KV cache coverage with TRT-LLM attention and DFlash2."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.default_fixture import DefaultServerBase
+from sglang.test.sgl_eval_utils import run_sgl_eval
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    _wait_for_gpu_idle_in_ci,
+    is_in_ci,
+    try_cached_model,
+    write_github_step_summary,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=800, stage="extra-b", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+MODEL_PATH = "meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4"
+DRAFT_MODEL_PATH = "RadixArk/Muse-Spark-Open-DFlash2"
+
+
+class TestMuseSparkUnifiedMemory(DefaultServerBase):
+    timeout = 3600
+    gsm8k_accuracy_thres = 0.93
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        # Use the gated-model credential only in this test and its server children.
+        if token := os.environ.get("HF_MUSE_SPARK_TOKEN"):
+            token_env = patch.dict(os.environ, {"HF_TOKEN": token})
+            token_env.start()
+            cls.addClassCleanup(token_env.stop)
+        cls.model = try_cached_model(MODEL_PATH)
+        cls.other_args = [
+            "--tp-size",
+            "4",
+            "--ep-size",
+            "4",
+            "--quantization",
+            "modelopt_fp4",
+            "--moe-runner-backend",
+            "flashinfer_trtllm",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "trtllm_mha",
+            "--page-size",
+            "128",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.8",
+            "--max-running-requests",
+            "128",
+            "--enable-layernorm-sp",
+            "--enable-megamoe-for-layernorm-sp",
+            "--speculative-algorithm",
+            "DFLASH",
+            "--speculative-draft-model-path",
+            try_cached_model(DRAFT_MODEL_PATH),
+            "--speculative-draft-attention-backend",
+            "fa4",
+            "--speculative-num-draft-tokens",
+            "8",
+            "--enable-unified-memory",
+            "--mm-feature-transport",
+            "cpu",
+            "--reasoning-parser",
+            "muse",
+            "--tool-call-parser",
+            "muse",
+        ]
+        super().setUpClass()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        super().tearDownClass()
+        _wait_for_gpu_idle_in_ci(timeout=120)
+
+    def test_gsm8k(self):
+        # Exercise decode/verify writes into the shared GQA/SWA pool with all
+        # 1,319 questions, including the FA4 draft's separate BF16 KV cache.
+        metrics = run_sgl_eval(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                base_url=self.base_url,
+                model=self.model,
+                eval_name="gsm8k",
+                num_examples=None,
+                num_threads=64,
+                sgl_eval_thinking=True,
+                reasoning_effort="xhigh",
+                max_tokens=32768,
+                temperature=1.0,
+                top_p=0.95,
+            )
+        )
+        result = json.loads(Path(metrics["sgl_eval_metrics_path"]).read_text())
+        self.assertEqual(result["num_examples"], 1319)
+        self.assertEqual(result["n_repeats"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics["error_rate"], 0.0)
+        if is_in_ci():
+            write_github_step_summary(
+                f"### Muse Spark NVFP4 unified memory (TP4/EP4)\n"
+                f"GSM8K (1319): {metrics['score']:.4f}\n"
+            )
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(metrics["score"], self.gsm8k_accuracy_thres)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
